q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
Q2 FY2027 ends in September 2026. NVIDIA typically reports earnings 3-4 weeks after quarter end. Today is August 23, 2026, so resolution is approximately 4-6 weeks away.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already issued forward guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ±2%**, which establishes a range of $89.2B to $92.8B.

The question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance" — this is asking for the guidance number NVIDIA announces, not the actual revenue result.

**The most likely outcome is that the forward guidance will be approximately $91.0 billion** because:
- This guidance was issued on May 20, 2026 (per the research)
- The question is asking what guidance NVIDIA will provide in its Q2 earnings release
- Companies typically revise guidance only when material changes occur
- No disruptions are mentioned in the research that would necessitate a major revision

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Unforeseen demand weakness or customer cancellations
- Geopolitical deterioration affecting export restrictions to additional regions beyond China
- Supply chain disruptions impacting production capacity
- Macro economic slowdown reducing AI capex spending
- Competitive pressure from AMD or other accelerator vendors materializing faster than expected
- Broader tech sector pullback

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger than expected demand for H100/H200 GPUs
- Acceleration of large language model buildouts by cloud providers
- Additional data center customers ramping faster than anticipated
- Potential reversal or loosening of China revenue restrictions (though guidance explicitly assumes zero China DC revenue)
- Better execution on new product launches
- Market share gains from competitors
- AI infrastructure capex cycle extending longer than expected

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027: NVIDIA reported $81.6B revenue, beating its own guidance midpoint by 4.6%
- NVIDIA has beaten guidance for 13 consecutive quarters
- However, the margin of beat has been "compressing"
- Wall Street consensus for Q2 FY2027 is $91.85-91.9B (slightly above the $91.0B midpoint)

The key insight: The question asks for **forward guidance**, not actual results. Forward guidance is what NVIDIA *announces* they expect to achieve in the *next* quarter. This is typically provided conservatively and revised only for material changes.

## Probability Distribution

Given that:
1. Official guidance of $91.0B ±2% ($89.2B-$92.8B) has been publicly stated
2. The range given (99.5B-115.5B) is significantly wider than the guidance range
3. There's insufficient time/rationale for a dramatic upward revision
4. Wall Street expects ~$91.9B actual results, suggesting confidence in the $91B guidance level
5. The beat margin is compressing, suggesting guidance is becoming more accurate

The distribution should center tightly around $91.0B with some spread for:
- Possibility of minor guidance revision upward (slight increases seem possible given compression of beats)
- Lower probability of major revision downward without visible catalyst
- The wide forecast range suggests uncertainty, but company guidance should still anchor near $91B

Low pressure cases: $89.0-90.5B (10th percentile ~89.5B)
Central cases: $90.5-91.5B (50th percentile ~91.0B)  
High cases: $91.5-93.5B (90th percentile ~92.5B)

Low (10th percentile): 89.5000000000
Median (50th percentile): 91.0000000000
High (90th percentile): 92.5000000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, is \$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance explicitly assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/) [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).

Wall Street analysts' average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around \$91.9 billion, with some sources citing \$91.85 billion, placing it slightly above NVIDIA's midpoint guidance [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/) [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). This estimate falls within NVIDIA's projected range, which has a ceiling near \$92.8 billion and a floor near \$89.2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

For Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported record revenue of \$81.6 billion, exceeding its own guidance midpoint by 4.6% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). The company's reported revenue has beaten its own guidance for 13 consecutive quarters, though the margin of beat has been compressing [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). Gross margins for Q2 FY2027 are expected to remain stable at approximately 74.9% (GAAP) and 75.0% (non-GAAP) [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
